title: Chat Slow Mode
description:
Slow mode allows at most `limit` **accepted** messages in any window of `window` seconds. A message sent at time `t` is accepted if fewer than `limit` accepted messages were sent at times greater than `t - window` (and at most `t`). Rejected messages do not count toward the limit.

`times` lists when each message was sent, in non-decreasing order. Return the 0-based indices of the rejected messages, in order.
